decision.reason: [ev-e4abe53a35a3] is just a one-line PR title from the GitHub release's "What's Changed" list. It names an internal code path (the APIEstablisher validate method now mutates MRDs the way it does CRDs). It doesn't say what gets mutated, how behaviour differs before and after, which environments are affected, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. To write the assertion we would need the content of PR #6660 or an upgrade or release note that describes the effect for operators.
